chars.K: KARIM: a man in his late thirties with a short black beard, wearing a dark green knitted sweater with one white stripe across the chest and beige chinos.
chars.S: SANAA: a woman in her early thirties wearing a mustard yellow hijab and a long burgundy dress.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Front door of a modern Casablanca apartment with a Moroccan salon behind. SANAA leaps joyfully into KARIM's arms with a huge smile as he steps in from work holding a doctor's envelope; KARIM looks frozen, worried and stiff, eyes wide. Comic awkward contrast between her joy and his panic.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: In the Moroccan salon with low banquettes and patterned cushions, SANAA proudly holds up a small white pregnancy test stick toward KARIM, beaming; KARIM's eyes pop wide in shock, mouth open, the doctor's envelope slipping from his hand.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: SANAA hugs her own belly tenderly and smiles with happy tears; KARIM stands next to her stunned, hand on his forehead, sweating, staring into space.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: SANAA dances happily around the salon, phone in hand calling family; KARIM sits on the banquette looking confused and lost, scratching his head.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: KARIM hugs SANAA in the salon; her face shows pure joy, his face over her shoulder shows a forced awkward smile with worried eyes.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Kitchen of the apartment: KARIM gives a big fake thumbs-up smile to SANAA who serves mint tea happily, while a drop of sweat runs down his face and his other hand nervously squeezes the doctor's envelope behind his back.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Night, dark bedroom lit by blue moonlight: SANAA sleeps peacefully smiling; KARIM lies awake beside her staring at the ceiling, holding a medical test report sheet, eyes wide, troubled.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Night, dim salon: KARIM stands in the doorway, suspicious narrowed eyes, staring at SANAA who is smiling at her glowing phone screen on the sofa, unaware of him. Tense suspicious mood.
